abstract: A review of 56 cases of primary malignant germ cell tumors of the mediastinum revealed that, as with benign teratomas, the tumors occurred in young adults (mean age 29 years) but that the sex distribution differed (86% male and 14% female). A single germ cell element was found in 37 (66%) of the tumors, and various combinations were present in the remaining 19 (34%). The tumors were classified among five recognized types of germ cell tissues. There were 24 seminomas (22 pure and two with mature teratomas), 17 embryonal carcinomas (nine pure and eight with mixtures), five teratomas, seven choriocarcinomas (three pure and four with mixtures), and three pure yolk sac tumors. Most (86%) of the patients were symptomatic at the initial examination, with chest pain, cough, and loss of weight being the most frequent presenting symptoms. The standard posteroanterior and lateral roentgenograms were the most helpful diagnostic tool, showing evidence of an anterior mediastinal mass in 53 patients. The diagnosis was established by surgical exploration of the mediastinum or by biopsy of a lymph node in 55 patients. Of the 55, 24 (43.6%) had complete resection of the tumor and 31 (56.4%) had incomplete resection or biopsy alone. The overall prognosis for mediastinal germ cell tumors is poor, partly because the tumors are far advanced at the time of diagnosis but also because some of the tumors that contain embryonal cell carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, and yolk sac elements are very aggressive. Factors that were prognostic in patients with seminoma--such as age, presence of the superior vena caval syndrome, lymphadenopathy, evidence of hilar disease on the chest roentgenogram, and resectability--were not predictive in patients with other types of malignant germ cell tumors. Although aggressive combination chemotherapy may represent a significant treatment modality for nonseminomatous mediastinal tumors, the present study spanned many years in which no chemotherapy was available. Patients in the later years of the study received combination chemotherapy with various treatment regimens. No conclusions concerning specific chemotherapy, therefore, can be derived from this study.
abstract_ja: 縦隔原発の悪性胚細胞腫瘍56例のレビューでは、良性奇形腫と同様に若年成人に発生することが示された(平均年齢29歳)。ただし性別分布は異なり、男性86%、女性14%であった。単一の胚細胞成分のみが37例(66%)で認められ、残りの19例(34%)では様々な組み合わせが認められた。腫瘍は胚細胞組織の5種類に分類された。セミノーマ24例(純粋型22例、成熟奇形腫を伴うもの2例)、胎児性癌17例(純粋型9例、混合型8例)、奇形腫5例、絨毛癌7例(純粋型3例、混合型4例)、卵黄嚢腫瘍3例(純粋型)であった。患者の大多数(86%)は初診時に症状を有しており、胸痛、咳嗽、体重減少が最も多い初発症状であった。標準的な前後方向および側面の胸部X線写真が最も有用な画像診断で、53例に前縦隔腫瘤を示した。診断は縦隔の外科的探索またはリンパ節生検により55例で確定した。このうち24例(43.6%)は腫瘍の完全切除を受け、31例(56.4%)は不完全切除または生検のみであった。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の全体的な予後は不良である。診断時に病期が進行していることが多いことに加え、胎児性癌、絨毛癌、卵黄嚢成分を含む腫瘍には非常に攻撃性の高いものがあるためである。セミノーマ患者では予後因子であった年齢、上大静脈症候群の有無、リンパ節腫大、胸部X線写真での肺門病変の有無、切除可能性などは、他の組織型の悪性胚細胞腫瘍では予後を予測しなかった。非セミノーマ性の縦隔腫瘍に対しては、積極的な併用化学療法が有効な治療手段となりうるが、本研究の期間の大部分では化学療法が存在しなかった。後年の患者では様々な治療レジメンによる併用化学療法を受けたが、本研究からは特定の化学療法に関する結論は導けない。
